items.title: George P. Fleming Interview, 1984-10-06
items.q: I never did play with Alvin. But Alvin was always around when I needed help.

ctx.x: Alcorn. I never did play with Alvin. But Alvin was always around when I needed help. Seemed like he would come in and out. And he helped me also.
Yeah. That's Alvin Alcorn, is it? Alcorn. A-L-C-O-R-N, yeah.
